items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] How come you used Dean Johnson? [INTERVIEWEE] I'm playing that.

ctx.x: even with the singers? The singers, no, we played them because we rehearsed them right there 12th and Central and the music was out there, you know, spikes was placed. And you were all, everything down, all we went right and set up and played them. It wasn't like you go there like they do now, you make a record and say, let's take another one, let's try this one. You never didn't know what you were doing, no? I was playing there, I never knew what I was doing. Couldn't tell, you know. Yeah.
How come you used Dean Johnson?
